response.sql: SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
